issues.description: Function 'ray_sphere_intersect' has inconsistent parameter lists across artifacts. In template header (example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h) the prototype declares three parameters: (const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center). In the template implementation (example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.cpp) and in the solution header the function is defined with a fourth parameter 'const float radius'. The example usage in main.cpp calls the 4-parameter version (origin, dir, center, radius). This mismatch between the template header and the implementation/solution will cause C++ compilation errors for students and prevents the provided example code from compiling and linking correctly.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the prototype in template_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h to match the implementation and solution: change the declaration to include the radius parameter. Example corrected signature: bool ray_sphere_intersect(const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center, const float radius); Ensure this header change keeps the educational intent and allows the provided main.cpp and implementation to compile together.

issues.description: The function concept 'ray_sphere_intersect' is inconsistently declared across artifacts. In the template header (example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h) the prototype is declared as bool ray_sphere_intersect(const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center); however the template implementation (example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.cpp) and the template main program call ray_sphere_intersect with four arguments and expect a radius parameter: bool ray_sphere_intersect(const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center, const float radius). The solution header declares the four-parameter prototype. This mismatch (header vs implementation and usage) prevents a clear mapping of the function's required parameters, will confuse students about the correct API, and will cause compilation errors or linkage issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template header prototype match the implementation and usage by adding the radius parameter. Replace the declaration in example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h with: bool ray_sphere_intersect(const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center, const float radius); Ensure the header in the template repository matches the solution header and the implementation to avoid compilation and cognitive mapping problems.
